request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Rebuild it as a sleek retro sci-fi hover-boat: the wooden hull becomes smooth rounded polished chrome and silver-white metal shaded soft blue-grey, with a dark gunmetal underside and two small fins; the mast and sail become one tall swept-back chrome fin; on the deck a clear pale glass dome cockpit with one white highlight; a row of small glowing hot magenta lights along the rim. Keep the size, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
